walkthrough_steps.detail: Type 'MI_Rooms_Paradise' in search bar to isolate all 96 MIs

walkthrough_steps.action: Open each MI and read current parent
walkthrough_steps.detail: Double-click MI → Details panel → Parent field. Record current parent.
For 13 MIs with _Atlas_01_Trans_Mat suffix: set parent to M_Master_Toon_Universal_Alpha. Set TextureWeight=1.0, LayerA_TextureWeight=1.0.
For 83 MIs without _Trans_Mat suffix: set parent to M_Master_Toon_Universal. Set TextureWeight=1.0, LayerA_TextureWeight=1.0.
Ctrl+S or right-click → Save. Verify no errors in Output Log.

guardrails: Verify parent master exists before reparenting
Transparent MIs MUST use Universal_Alpha parent
